components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dependable ink action for completing an operational task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 85%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: A coral action reserved for meaningful CP emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for secondary operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--secondary); border-color: var(--input); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A calm, clearly labelled square field for operational input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 500 14px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--subtle-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--input); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Revision-label style: compact uppercase, tracked, square.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--muted-foreground); border-radius: 0; font: 600 11px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Danger Badge
components.description: A coral urgency badge for overdue or attention states.
components.css: .ds-chip-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--brand); color: #fff; border-radius: 0; font: 600 11px/1.3 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A quiet ruled paper surface for grouped operational information.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 18px/1.3 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.description: Dark binder-cover navigation with numbered sheets and a coral active marker.

narrative.overview: Each route is a numbered sheet in an architect's project binder. The sidebar is a binder-cover sheet index. Title blocks, ruled panels, drawing-register language, and revision marks structure the interface. The canvas is warm vellum; structure is ink; the coral signature accent is scarce and deliberate. The tool is Operate-mode: scanability and consistency outrank expression, and the same semantic token system carries a light (vellum) and dark (night drafting room) mode with a WCAG AA contrast floor.
keyCharacteristics: Each route is a numbered sheet; the sidebar is the binder-cover sheet index.
Square geometry (0px radius) — avatars and status dots are the only circles.
Hairline borders and tonal layering carry hierarchy; shadows only on floating surfaces.
Warm vellum canvas, ink structure, scarce coral accent.
Bricolage Grotesque display, Spline Sans body, JetBrains Mono for measured data.
Light and dark modes share one semantic token system.

rules.name: The Scarcity of Color Rule
rules.body: A screen should read clearly in grayscale. Accent color marks action, state, or CP emphasis; it does not fill every component.

rules.name: The Square Geometry Rule
rules.body: Square geometry throughout: 0px radius on cards, buttons, inputs, badges, progress and revenue bars; circular (full) only for avatars and status dots.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Hairline borders carry structure. Shadows are reserved for surfaces that float above the work surface — dialogs, dropdowns, notification panels. Resting elements use tonal layering and borders, never shadows.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Use shadcn semantic tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border) for all styling; never raw color utilities in page components.

rules.name: The One Icon Family Rule
rules.body: Lucide is the only icon family — tree-shakeable and visually consistent. Mixing icon families is not allowed.

dos: Do let hairline borders, dividers, and tonal surfaces carry hierarchy.
Do use tabular figures for all numeric data.
Do use the coral accent sparingly for signature moments.
Do provide visible focus, keyboard access, reduced-motion alternatives, and 44px touch targets.
Do use SGD and en-SG formatting for financial and date information.
Do use shadcn semantic tokens for all styling.
donts: Don't use gradients, icon tiles, or decorative hover lifts.
Don't use rounded-full on anything except circular indicators (avatars, status dots).
Don't use shadows on resting elements.
Don't use raw color utilities (bg-white, text-black) in page components — use semantic tokens.
Don't mix icon families — Lucide is the only icon library.
Don't introduce literal route-level colors or arbitrary radius values without a token.
Don't make the internal tool read like a public marketing landing page.
